units.source_text: “女人和男人一起干活，没有什么稀奇的。

en.t: There is nothing unusual about women and men working together.
That is just how farming people are.

units.source_text: 卖菜的、卖鱼的何尝不是……”真砂子轻快地说，

en.t: It is the same with vegetable sellers and fish sellers, is it not... Masako said lightly,

units.source_text: “像你这样的小姐才看见什么都钦佩呢。”

en.t: Only a young lady like you would admire everything she sees.
